About.label: about
About.title: Small team, deep work.
paragraphs: efface is an engineering team building AI, web, and app products. Planning, design, development, deployment, operations — we handle it end to end, ourselves.

We chose depth over headcount. New tech doesn't stop at a demo here; it goes into real products and gets proven there. The backdrop on this page isn't a video — it's a 3D scene rendering live in your browser.
A good product is one that keeps working. We take solid structure over flashy features, and getting it right over getting it out.
